Stated GitHub description: A project to mess around with audio processing, cryptography, and general creepiness - the objective is to take a piece of text, convert it into numbers via some manner, then use text-to-speech to generate an audio file of those numbers. Beyond that, goals include intro/outro music, addition of distortion similar to that heard on shortwave radios, and saving generated content as mp3s.
